2608.14456.title: Shift Aware Transfer Learning with Adaptive Dual-Encoder Fusion for PM Forecasting in Data-Limited Environments
2608.14456.paper_summary: Short-horizon forecasting of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) remains difficult when observations from the target domain are limited and the statistical properties of the source and target domains differ. In these settings, models trained only on local data may not capture complex temporal dynamics, while direct transfer learning can result in negative transfer. This study develops a shift-aware dual-encoder transfer framework that combines source-domain knowledge with target-specific representation learning. The source encoder was pretrained using hourly observations from 10 U.S. monitoring locations. The framework was then adapted and evaluated using two years of hourly observations from 77 stations in Taiwan under a chronological train-validation-test protocol. Among the four principal baselines, the frozen-source dual-encoder model achieved the best performance, with MSE = 21.8960, MAE = 3.1597, and R^2 = 0.8725. This corresponds to an MSE reduction of approximately 7.1% relative to TL-v1 and 4.1% relative to TL-v2. The ablation analysis showed that removing the Taiwan-specific branch caused the largest decline in performance. Allowing the source encoder to adapt produced the best overall result, with MSE = 21.6575, MAE = 3.1383, and R^2 = 0.8739. SHAP analysis indicated that predictions were driven mainly by recent PM2.5 observations and meteorological variables related to pollutant transport and dispersion. These results suggest that source-domain knowledge is most effective when target-specific information is preserved and the transferred representation is allowed to adapt under target supervision.
2608.14456.paper_summary_zh: 短期預測細懸浮微粒 (PM2.5) 仍然困難，當目標領域的觀測數據有限且來源領域與目標領域的統計特性不同時。在這些情況下，僅基於本地數據訓練的模型可能無法捕捉複雜的時間動態，而直接轉移學習可能導致負轉移。本研究開發了一種具變化感知的雙編碼器轉移框架，結合了來源領域的知識與目標特定的表示學習。來源編碼器使用來自美國10個監測地點的每小時觀測數據進行了預訓練。然後，該框架在台灣77個站點的兩年每小時觀測數據上進行了調整和評估，遵循時間順序的訓練-驗證-測試協議。在四個主要基準中，凍結來源的雙編碼器模型達到了最佳性能，MSE = 21.8960，MAE = 3.1597，R^2 = 0.8725。這相對於TL-v1的MSE減少了約7.1%，相對於TL-v2減少了4.1%。消融分析顯示，去除台灣特定分支導致性能下降最大。允許來源編碼器適應產生了最佳的整體結果，MSE = 21.6575，MAE = 3.1383，R^2 = 0.8739。SHAP分析表明，預測主要受到近期PM2.5觀測數據和與污染物傳輸及擴散相關的氣象變數的驅動。這些結果表明，當保留目標特定信息並允許轉移表示在目標監督下適應時，來源領域的知識最為有效。
